scoring.causal_mechanism_regressions: 20 only if the frozen 2688 controls and 124 controlled-corruption cases pass with no failures, plus all scoped JVM/native parity tests. New extra test counts earn no extra points.
scoring.frozen_real_reference_coverage: 20 multiplied by the usable distinct reference/side configurations in the frozen complete-reference MP33 cohort, denominator fixed at 32. Do not use the overlapping 96 source runs as independent references.
scoring.real_camera_exercise_breadth: 15 multiplied by supported policy IDs with at least one real-camera MP33 reference passing the production calibration gates, divided by the six frozen policy IDs. Skeletal-only data earns no points in this category.
scoring.independent_label_validation: 10 for independent skeletal labels, 10 for independent RGB-to-pose per-rep labels. Each requires frozen subject-disjoint test data covering at least two supported exercise variants, at least 30 correct and 30 incorrect test repetitions, at least three test subjects, counted-rep precision >=0.90, good-rep recall >=0.70 and assessable coverage >=0.80. Score the two domains separately; do not infer camera performance from skeletal results. No new manual labelling is required; licensed existing labels may be used.
scoring.android_runtime_validation: 5 for all scoped native tests on the available emulator. Another 5 for the same suite on a second Android API runtime. Another 5 for a physical Android handset. Static ABI/16KB checks alone earn no additional runtime points. Universal-device compatibility is not required.
scoring.sustained_live_performance: 5 for at least 10 continuous minutes of real model camera inference with p95 capture-to-result latency <=200ms and >=5 delivered FPS after warmup, bounded admission/queue and no model mismatch, crash or ANR. Another 5 for measured total PSS <=768MiB and <10% growth between the first and last post-warmup 2-minute windows in the same run. Record the host/device/model explicitly; this is device-specific performance.

milestone_gates: Computed raw score must be >=70 and all scored evidence must be reproducible and bound to a committed implementation.
At least one independent-label domain must meet its 10-point requirements; otherwise cap the reported score at 69.
No existing calibration reference may be lost without an explicitly documented correctness reason; any loss must appear in the comparison report.
Do not relax confidence, provenance, range or fault checks merely to raise coverage or the readiness score.
Do not change weights, the 32-reference denominator, the six policy IDs, independent test subjects or gates during this milestone run.
Readiness >=70 is not a production release, medical validation or a measured 70%/98% human-form precision claim.
baseline_note: The earlier user-facing 40/100 was a subjective estimate. Formalizing it as 42.5 is not an engine improvement. This score is not calibrated against user outcomes.
